units.title: Execute one owner-real outcome-continuation CLI observation
units.objective: Bind the canonical Plan 55 compact-context owner result to the unchanged Plan 114 CLI, retain the admitted next action and manual-friction readout, and select the first evidence-supported runtime integration seam without implementing or promoting it.

included: One strict checked-in scenario bound to the canonical Plan 55 owner result
Exact configuration and file-context output digest re-observation
One public CLI allow decision for the named Plan 115 evidence write
One revision-bound manual observation artifact and next-seam readout
Focused Plan 114 regression and Plan 115 truth-surface reconciliation
excluded: Pre-write, session, claim, heartbeat, commit, closeout, or shell adapters
Mutable lease persistence or automatic progress classification
Outcome enforcement, break glass, fleet installation, colleague packaging, or external-user validation
Spend, subscription, elapsed-time, deployment, or release controls

outputs: Reproduced Plan 55 configuration and output digests
Allowed active-in-scope continuation result from the unchanged public CLI
Evidence-supported next integration seam with a falsification condition

acceptance.criterion: The scenario binds the canonical Plan 55 owner result to its exact merge, configuration digest, command, file-context output digest, and artifact references.
evidence_required: Checked-in strict scenario accepted by OutcomeContinuationScenarioV1
Re-executed configuration and file-context digest commands
acceptance.negative_control: A different configuration or stdout digest is preserved as a mismatch rather than accepted as the same progress evidence.

acceptance.criterion: The unchanged public CLI leaves the lease active and admits the exact Plan 115 evidence write as active_in_scope while approval, cost, and elapsed context remain ignored.
evidence_required: CLI JSON result and exit code from a clean candidate revision
acceptance.negative_control: The retained Plan 114 circular scenario remains denied as recovery_required with the same decision-inert operator context.

acceptance.criterion: The retained observation is revision- and digest-bound and truthfully classified as manual CLI delivery, with no hook, claim, shell, enforcement, colleague, or fleet claim.
evidence_required: Truthful Plan 115, index, and roadmap text
acceptance.negative_control: The evidence limitations explicitly reject automatic or hard-enforcement interpretations.

acceptance.criterion: The manual-friction readout selects the smallest candidate integration seam and states an observation that would falsify that recommendation.
evidence_required: Named next seam and falsification condition
acceptance.negative_control: No lifecycle adapter is implemented merely because it was plausible before the run.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One exact live Plan 115 claim owns only the listed scenario, evidence, plan, graph, index, and roadmap paths.
